At low T, sigma falls with eps at large strain, while at high T it rises with eps.
- The temperature dependence is strong and superlinear above T ≈ 3.

A full linear basis in {1, ln eps, eps, √eps, 1/eps} × {1, T, T², T³} reaches NMSE ≈ 1.7e-5, so the structure is close to these terms but not exact.
